researched.description: Fundraising, fund accounting, and constituent management software for nonprofits, foundations, K-12 schools, and universities
researched.notes: Named by the owner as a scope_review example. Sells across the whole nonprofit/social-impact market, of which public universities and school districts are one slice.

researched.description: Institutional performance analytics, cost analytics, and assessment software for colleges and universities
researched.notes: Spun out of the University of Maryland Global Campus Office of Analytics; customer base is higher-ed institutions including public systems.

researched.description: School and college search data platform selling enrollment marketing and direct admissions to universities and K-12 districts
researched.notes: Site is behind a PerimeterX block for both WebFetch and curl; facts confirmed from Wikipedia, Crunchbase News, and Pittsburgh Technology Council coverage. Founded 2002 as College Prowler, renamed Niche in 2013. Judgment call: they run a data/lead platform but also market themselves as an enrollment marketing agency, so the product-vs-services line is worth a second look.

researched.description: Digital rewards and payout platform issuing prepaid cards, gift cards, and cash disbursements for research, employee, and customer programs
researched.notes: Horizontal incentives/payouts vendor - market research, employee engagement, healthcare, sales. No government-specific offering visible on the site; exhibited at a higher-ed business officers show.

researched.description: AI noise monitoring sensors and evidence reporting for councils, environment departments, and other noise regulators
researched.notes: No URL was supplied; found via search at noisenet.com (also noisenet.com.au). Category is a judgment call - noise-nuisance complaint handling sits between citizen services and code enforcement, and their Animal Care Expo presence is about barking-dog complaints.

researched.description: Property tax escrow, bulk payment, and payment processing platform for county and municipal tax offices
researched.notes: Legal entity is Autoagent Data Solutions, LLC; the site brands as Autoagent.

researched.description: Utility billing and customer information systems for municipal water, sewer, and small utilities
researched.notes: Full legal name Continental Utility Solutions, Inc. Site claims 40+ years but gives no founding year, so the year is omitted.

researched.description: Grants management software for foundations and government grantmaking agencies, plus a grantseeker portal
researched.notes: Candidate name was "Fluxx Labs"; the company writes itself as Fluxx. Named state customers include Michigan, California, and the Texas Veterans Commission. Site says "over 15 years" but no founding year, so the year is omitted.

researched.description: Financial close, consolidation, and planning software for large enterprises
researched.notes: Horizontal enterprise CPM platform - 1,900+ customers, 21% of the Fortune 500. Has a public-sector segment but is not govtech-specific.

researched.description: Revenue recognition and complex billing software for enterprises with subscription, consumption, and milestone revenue models
researched.notes: Horizontal revenue lifecycle vendor across telecom, software, and entertainment, with a public-sector chargeback offering. Founding year appears as both 1995 and 1999 in third-party profiles and is absent from the company's own site, so it is omitted.

researched.description: Permitting, code enforcement, land use, and request management software for municipalities, townships, and counties
researched.notes: Brands itself SDL on the site; the legal/LinkedIn name is Spatial Data Logic. Site claims 26+ years but names no founding year, so the year is omitted. 260+ local government clients.

researched.description: Background check, drug screening, and employment verification services for employers, staffing firms, and volunteer organizations
researched.notes: Judgment call: PBSA-accredited screening bureau selling a service (with a portal and ATS integrations) across every industry, not a government software product. If the owner counts screening platforms as products, this would instead be a horizontal scope_review.

researched.description: Cloud school nutrition software covering cafeteria point of sale, meal pre-ordering, free and reduced applications, and payments for K-12 districts and caterers
researched.notes: The supplied URL (menulogic-k12.com, now menulogic.io) belongs to a DIFFERENT company - MenuLogic K12, operated by Foodworks Technologies, LLC, which sells menu-planning and business-intelligence software. The candidate name "Meal Manage Inc." and the vertical "school meal ordering and payment software" match MealManage Inc. at mealmanage.com, so this card is written for MealManage. Worth a second look if the exhibitor list actually meant MenuLogic. No HQ or founding year published on the site.

researched.description: Outage notification, billing, and omnichannel customer communication platform for investor-owned, municipal, and cooperative utilities
researched.notes: Legal name Convey, LLC; rebranded from Message Broadcast. Utilities are the lead market but the platform is also sold into finance, healthcare, insurance, and telecom, so a horizontal read is defensible. No founding year on the site.

researched.description: Road and bridge project development software covering estimating, electronic bidding, construction management, and materials testing for state DOTs, counties, and municipalities
researched.notes: No URL was supplied; found at exevision.com. The candidate vertical said "asset and permit software" - that describes iWorQ Systems, a different Utah local-gov vendor, not ExeVision, whose products are iPDWeb, iCXWeb, and eFieldbook for transportation projects (fits NACE, the county engineers show). Founding year left blank: the site says "since 2005" for transportation work while third-party profiles say the company was founded in 1994.

researched.description: Matter, contract, and spend management workspace for in-house legal teams
researched.notes: No URL was supplied; found at lawvu.com. Horizontal in-house legal ops platform sold across industries; municipal law departments (the IMLA audience) are one segment, not the product's focus.

researched.description: Family caregiver education and support platform licensed by Area Agencies on Aging, state aging units, and health plans
researched.notes: Site blocks WebFetch and curl (CleanTalk bot protection); deployment confirmed via dozens of live agency-branded subdomains (e.g. coaaa.trualta.com, aaaphx.trualta.com). HQ appears as Toronto in most profiles and Ottawa in one, so treat the city as lightly held.

researched.description: Risk and needs assessment, case planning, and case management software for county probation, juvenile justice, and correctional agencies
researched.notes: No founding year published on the site.

researched.description: Cloud diversion program management, eLearning, citation processing, and document management for prosecutors, probation, and police agencies
researched.notes: Site brands the company "Adventfs" and its products "Advent"; flagship is Diversion Manager (diversionmanager.com). HQ from third-party business profiles - the contact page lists no address - so treat the city as lightly held. No founding year found.

researched.description: AquaTwin digital twin software for water and sewer hydraulic modeling, surge analysis, and asset management, sold to water utilities and engineering consultants
researched.notes: Esri partner; product line is AquaTwin Water, Sewer, Surge, Asset, and HCM. No founding year published on the site or in the profiles found.

researched.description: Digital payment, billing, and reconciliation platform integrated with ERP for municipalities, counties, and public agencies
researched.notes: Site's Why CORE page states HQ in East Providence, RI and "since its inception in 1986"; the page footer shows a Chicago, IL address, which appears to be a second office. 1,600+ public sector, government, and higher-ed customers.

researched.description: Capital program and construction project management software for infrastructure owners including federal, state, and local agencies
researched.notes: FedRAMP authorized since 2022; named public customers include the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers and the Pennsylvania Turnpike Commission. Also sells to commercial, healthcare, and education owners, so a horizontal read is arguable, but the product is construction-vertical rather than general-purpose.

researched.description: Springboard utility billing, customer information, and field operations software for electric, water, and municipal utilities
researched.notes: Goes by PCS. Site claims 40+ years but names no founding year, so the year is omitted.

researched.description: Automated text, voice, email, and mail notification software that turns AMI meter data into leak alerts and service outage messages for water utilities
researched.notes: HQ and founding year omitted: several unrelated companies named Spout appear in the business databases and none could be matched to spoutservices.com with confidence, while the site itself publishes no address.

researched.description: Operations data logging, sampling, and regulatory compliance reporting software for water and wastewater systems
researched.notes: Products are Rounds, Assets, and Samples. HQ and year come from third-party profiles; the site's contact page still shows placeholder address text.

researched.description: Career EDGE case management, labor exchange, and career readiness software for state and local workforce agencies, education, and reentry programs
researched.notes: careeredge.com 301-redirects to careerteam.com; Career EDGE is the platform, Career TEAM the company. They also sell change-management and implementation services alongside the software, so the product/services mix is worth a look. No founding year on the site.

researched.description: Identity risk and synthetic fraud detection scores used at account application by banks, credit unions, telecoms, and government programs
researched.notes: Horizontal identity/fraud data platform - core market is financial institutions (13 of the 15 largest US banks), with government among 500+ other customers. Exhibited at NASWA because of unemployment-insurance fraud.

researched.description: Payment processing, core banking, and disbursement technology for financial institutions, merchants, and large enterprises
researched.notes: Fortune 500 horizontal fintech infrastructure provider; government disbursements (e.g. UI benefit cards) are one line of business among many.

researched.description: CMS, online forms, events, and citizen portal platform for municipal and local government websites
researched.notes: A registered trademark of GHD Group Limited and run inside GHD Digital, an engineering/consulting firm - but Govstack itself is a productized SaaS suite, which is why this is govtech rather than supplier. Waterloo, Ontario is the primary office; Tampa is the US HQ. No founding year published.

researched.description: Produced telephone town halls, text alerts, voice broadcasts, and direct mail campaigns for municipalities, school districts, unions, and campaigns
researched.notes: Judgment call: the site describes campaigns customized and produced by their own team rather than a self-serve platform, which reads as a managed communications service. If the owner counts hosted tele-town-hall systems as products, reclassify as govtech / General Gov / Citizen Services. No HQ published on the site.

researched.description: Issue tracking, project management, and team collaboration software for software and business teams
researched.notes: Horizontal collaboration software (Jira, Confluence) with a government edition; not govtech-specific.

researched.description: Data backup, immutable storage, and cyber recovery software for enterprise IT
researched.notes: Horizontal data security/resilience vendor with a FedRAMP public-sector line; sells across every industry.

researched.description: Google Cloud, Workspace, and AI services resold and supported for US federal, state, local, and education customers
researched.notes: A subsidiary/division of Google LLC announced June 2022, not an independent company. The candidate URL cloud.google.com/gov redirects into Google Cloud; the division's own site is publicsector.google. Big-tech cloud, which the owner flagged as scope_review territory.

researched.description: Business intelligence, data integration, and analytics software for enterprises
researched.notes: Horizontal BI/data platform; founded 1993 in Lund, Sweden, now US-headquartered.

researched.description: Browser security software that protects credentials, blocks phishing, and governs employee AI tool use inside existing browsers
researched.notes: Legal name Secto AI, Inc. Horizontal enterprise browser security aimed at regulated industries generally, not a government product. No founding year published.

researched.notes: GovLink cited on the site as serving 318+ counties; PeachCourt is the Georgia court eFiling system. No founding year published.

researched.description: AI browser extension that generates lesson plans, quizzes, and student feedback inside Google Workspace and LMS tools for teachers and school districts
researched.notes: Sells to individual teachers and to districts (site claims 20,000 districts); $5M seed led by Owl Ventures 2024, $15M Series A led by Bessemer 2025. HQ omitted: funding coverage puts it in San Francisco, other profiles in Los Altos, CA, and the site publishes no address.

researched.description: EdTech inventory, vetting, contract, and renewal management software for K-12 school districts
researched.notes: No URL was supplied; found at veracityvs.com. Legal name Veracity Verification Solutions; the site brands as Veracity. Founding year omitted - third-party profiles split between 2020 and 2021 and the site gives none.

researched.description: Cyber readiness platform for schools and trusts covering security scoring, phishing simulation, policy building, staff training, and penetration testing
researched.notes: UK-founded (by a former headteacher and a compliance specialist) and acquired by Wonde in August 2022; runs a US site at /en-us, which fits the CoSN listing. researched.description: Managed endpoint detection and response, identity threat detection, and SIEM for small and mid-sized organizations, largely delivered through managed service providers
researched.notes: Horizontal managed cybersecurity across 270k+ organizations in every industry; education and government are segments, not the focus.
